payload.title: Resolution changes on real data
payload.summary: This notebook explores the effects of resolution changes on marine sediment core U1308 by applying the LERM method. It aims to recreate Figure 8 from a referenced publication. The analysis involves loading oxygen isotope data from Pangaea and performing LERM analysis on the data binned to different resolutions. The notebook uses various scientific computing libraries to handle data processing and visualization.
goals: Recreate Figure 8 from the original publication.
Explore resolution effects on marine sediment core U1308 using LERM.

section_blurbs.blurb: The notebook begins by loading the U1308 oxygen isotope data from Pangaea and proceeds to apply LERM analysis on the data binned to different resolutions. It aims to recreate Figure 8 from the original publication, focusing on the effects of resolution changes.
section_blurbs.heading: Resolution changes on real data

inputs: U1308 oxygen isotope data from Pangaea
